speaker: Olivia Park
text: Thanks for joining, everyone. Today we're agreeing the launch plan for offline mode, which leaves beta at the end of the month.

speaker: Alex Morgan
text: Quick status from product: the three pilot customers have been using it for two weeks, and sync conflicts are down to a handful a day.

speaker: Tom Becker
text: Support has seen four tickets about offline mode so far, all about photos uploading slowly on weak connections.

speaker: Alex Morgan
text: That's a known limit. Photos upload last, after the job updates, so a weak signal delays them. We'll mention it in the release notes.

speaker: Olivia Park
text: For the launch itself, I'd like a blog post, an email to all customers and a short video showing a technician closing a job in a basement.

speaker: Tom Becker
text: Can we also update the help center before the email goes out? Otherwise the first questions land on my team.

speaker: Olivia Park
text: Good point. Tom, I'll need the help center articles updated by the 26th so the email can link to them.

speaker: Tom Becker
text: I'll update the three offline articles by the 26th and add a troubleshooting section for photo uploads.

speaker: Alex Morgan
text: I'll record the demo video with Mei next week. We'll film it in the office basement, where there's genuinely no signal.

speaker: Olivia Park
text: Perfect. Let's send the customer email on the 28th, after the help center is ready.

speaker: Tom Becker
text: Will offline mode be on for everyone automatically, or do customers need to turn it on?

speaker: Alex Morgan
text: On for everyone. Admins can switch it off per team if they want, but the default is on.

speaker: Olivia Park
text: Great. I'll draft the blog post and the email this week and share them for review by Friday.

speaker: Alex Morgan
text: Sounds good. Let's follow up in this channel once the drafts are ready.
